item.text:
Dear Librarian,

I’m writing to ask whether the library would be interested in a donation of local photographs from my family’s collection. They show streets, buildings, community events, and everyday life in the area over several decades, and I wondered whether they might be useful for your local history collection.

Some photographs have names and dates written on the back, but others are unlabelled, and a few dates are uncertain. I would be happy to share what I know about their background and help identify any people or locations I recognize.

Please let me know whether you would like to see a few sample images or arrange a time to look through the collection.

Kind regards,
[Your Name]
